# Zeroing

> Zeroing is a community of homegrown, made-in-India brands based in New Delhi. Brands stand together like stalls in one lane: they open doors for each other, share customers and suppliers, and each sells from its own shop. Zeroing also runs Independent Society, a long-form podcast about working life in India, and The Other Details, a research lab that traces every number it publishes to its source.

## Brands
- [INDSO](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/indso): Botanical skincare gels, made in India. Shop: https://indso.in.
- [Ampor Eyewear](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/ampor-eyewear): Eyewear, made in India. Shop: https://ampor.in.
- [Vedi Kade](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/vedi-kade): Modern clothing that carries Tamil history.
- [Syzygy Living](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/syzygy-living): Design homeware.

## Pages
- [Home](https://zeroingnow.com/): what Zeroing is and why it exists
- [Community](https://zeroingnow.com/community): the brands and what we learned from similar efforts
- [Shop the lane](https://zeroingnow.com/shop): buy from each brand on its own shop; practices labelled Founder says, Proof shared or Checked by Zeroing
- [Independent Society](https://zeroingnow.com/independent-society): the podcast, hosted by Anshul Kumar, on Spotify
- [Akanksha Sood Singh episode](https://zeroingnow.com/episodes/akanksha-sood-singh): wildlife filmmaker, two parts
- [The Other Details](https://zeroingnow.com/the-other-details/): research lab studies on data centres and gold, and short reels
- [Join](https://zeroingnow.com/join): how a brand applies
- [Contact](https://zeroingnow.com/contact): zeroingindia@gmail.com, Instagram @zeroingnow

## Notes
- Zeroing does not sell products itself and takes no payment.
- Claims about how brands make things are labelled by how far they have been checked.
